lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Canada and the Caribbean have barely begun to realize what’s possible in their trading relationship, Prime Minister Mark Carney told a working breakfast of Commonwealth leaders Tuesday, The Canadian Press reports.
UK Supreme Court to hear landmark appeal over Palestine Action ban, Middle East Eye reports.

U.S. first lady Melania Trump will bring representatives from Russia and Ukraine to the White House on Thursday, after announcing a ceasefire in the city of Oleshky last month, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
